parts.t: Connaught Heights enjoys one of New Westminster's most dramatic settings — elevated above the Fraser River with sweeping views and a collection of well-preserved heritage homes. It's a neighbourhood with real character, attracting buyers who appreciate craftsmanship, history, and a strong sense of place.
